text:
Incident Bot: :rotating_light: ALERT — GPU queue growing in region-us-west2. autoscaler reported repeated scale failures; queue length jumped 3.2x over 7m. Affected routes: /v1/generate (high-p90 latency), embeddings.

Maya L.: paging CJ (on-call). I see the alert, jumping in.

CJ: on it. first pass — is this new deploy related or pure capacity?

Drew: not a deploy from my side. Metrics show GPU pool 'gpu-us-west2-pool' at 96% memory and 100% utilization of VMs. Autoscaler logs showing `max_replicas reached` then `scale_up_failed: quota_exceeded` repeatedly.

Anika: seeing heavy sustained batch sizes from a small subset of customers — long prompt medians. Might be a spike in long-tail inference.

Maya L.: quick mitigation plan: 1) reduce batch sizes for host-level routing 2) open fallback to `redwood-lite-v1` (smaller model) for best-effort requests 3) enable throttling for non-SLA customers. Who can flip the routing?

CJ: I can toggle routing. Doing `rctl route set --route /v1/generate --fallback redwood-lite-v1 --weight 20` now. (will monitor)

Drew: trying a scale command but provider quotas blocking. Running `infractl scale-pool gpu-us-west2-pool --replicas 12` returns `403 QuotaExceeded: per-project GPU quota reached`.

Incident Bot: (automated) New error stream from autoscaler: `Scale attempt 6 failed: InsufficientQuotaError` — retrying suppressed.

Maya L.: Samir, can you triage whether customers are impacted (errors vs throttling)? Need to notify support if SLAs risk.

Samir: pulling error logs now. Early numbers: 8% 5xxs on generation endpoints, majority are 429 throttles. One enterprise customer hitting retry storm — support ticket flagged.

Support Bot: Created ticket #INC-4521 and notified Customer Success for the enterprise account "ClearSky".

Elena: did the traffic-shaping change take effect? p95 for /v1/generate dropped a bit but p99 still high.

CJ: weight 20 fallback is live. Request distribution: 82% main model, 18% lite. Queue growth slowed but not stable.

Anika: enabling KV-prefix caching for frequent prefixes might buy us a little token savings. Rolling cache policy to production for effected routes.

Drew: provider is reporting soft limit — we have unused quota in other regions. Suggest failover by routing a slice of traffic to region-us-east1 where spare GPUs exist. That will add ~70ms latency for some customers.

Maya L.: proposal: route 15% to us-east1 for non-enterprise, keep enterprise on us-west2 if SLA. CJ ok to change?

CJ: yep, applying region-based policy: `rctl route region-split --route /v1/generate --us-west2 85 --us-east1 15 --preserve-sla enterprise`

Incident Bot: (info) Routing change accepted. Background sync to edge nodes in progress.

Samir: Support message drafted to ClearSky: "We are seeing elevated latencies due to GPU capacity and have applied routing and fallback mitigations. A dedicated update will follow with estimated ETA." Sending now.

Elena: heads-up — we observed one internal job that accidentally switched to high-parallel mode earlier and generated a lot of long sequences — filing that on the repo. Could be correlated.

Anika: small config snippet we flipped to reduce batch size: ```
# reduced from 64 -> 32
inference:
  batch_size: 32
  max_concurrent_requests: 8
```

Drew: after region-split and fallback, queue length is trending down, retry rate decreasing. Autoscaler still shows failed attempts but no new scale requests for 5m.

Maya L.: handing over to Drew for night ops. I'll create incident record and postmortem draft. Key open items for handoff: quota request to cloud (increase GPU quota in us-west2 by +20), follow-up on autoscaler failure mode, investigate internal job that spiked long sequences, add throttling policy per-customer.

CJ: thumbs up. tagging @Drew as new responder. :white_check_mark:

Drew: taking over. I'll watch for 30m, and coordinate with infra to request quota increase. Current status: mitigations stable, customer impact limited to throttles and increased p99 for some customers.

(30m later)

Drew: update — provider opened a quota ticket; they can provision +8 GPUs in ~2h if approved. Until then, routing & fallback keep tail latencies acceptable. 5xxs down to ~1.2%.

Samir: sending update to affected customers with ETA and workaround notes. Support queue handled the ClearSky case with temporary higher-priority routing to keep them on main pool.

Maya L.: POST-INCIDENT: initial summary for postmortem — short list: 1) root cause: autoscaler didn't handle concurrent quota failures and suppressed retries leading to queue backlog; 2) contributing: sudden high-long-sequence workload from internal job + insufficient region quota; 3) mitigations applied: routing fallback, region split, reduce batch sizes, KV caching, temporary throttles; 4) customer impact: limited throttling (429) and elevated p99 ~2-3x for ~1 hour for a small subset of customers; 5) immediate action items.

Anika: proposed action items (short): - fix autoscaler retry logic and add circuit-breaker for quota errors - add cross-region failover playbook - implement per-customer rate limits and backoff guidance - quota runbook to proactively request +25% buffer - post-deploy synthetic load test for long-sequence traffic.

Drew: I'll own autoscaler fix (A1) and the follow-up remediation PR. ETA: 2 weeks for code fix + 1 week for canary.

Maya L.: I'll own runbooks and alert tuning (A2). Will add a dedicated alert when autoscaler sees >=3 quota failures in 10m.

Samir: Support will send final customer communication after we have ETA/rate-limit guidance.

Elena: adding item to CI to disallow runaway internal jobs without rate caps.

Maya L.: closing incident thread — monitoring for 1h then will mark resolved. Thanks all. :pray:

Incident Bot: Incident marked as acknowledged. Remember to file incident report in /incidents and link this thread.
